parameters.name: KnowledgeBaseId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the knowledge base.

parameters.name: MaxContextChars
parameters.description: The maximum number of context characters. Valid values: 1000 to 32000.

parameters.name: RerankEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable reranking. Default value: false.

parameters.name: ReturnSources
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return citation sources. Default value: true.

parameters.name: SearchMode
parameters.description: The search mode. Valid values: knn, rrf, precise, semantic, and balanced.

parameters.name: TopK
parameters.description: The number of results to recall during retrieval.
